caption: The drawing depicts a formal men's outfit shown from the front, consisting of several distinct garments. There is a black tailcoat with long sleeves and a double-breasted design, buttoned at the waist and cut away in the front with extended tails at the back. Underneath the tailcoat, a cream-colored or light beige single-breasted waistcoat with buttons is visible, along with matching light-colored trousers. The outfit includes a high-collared white shirt and a dark cravat tied in a bow around the neck. The illustration is rendered in muted tones, primarily black and shades of cream or beige. In the upper right corner, there is a faint, line-drawn back view of the tailcoat, showing seam and button placement on the rear side. The background of the image is plain and off-white. No human features are present as the garments are shown without a model, with only the neck area of the shirt filled in.
title: Boy's Coat and Trousers
